LESSON: MULTIPLICATION

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade two
Subject: General
Strand: NUMBERS
Topic 1.5: Multiplication
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 10

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Multiplication, part of NUMBERS in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade two General.

Key inquiry question: How can you work out multiplication using repeated addition? 2) How do model multiplication as repeated addition?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Multiplication together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Learning to learn: Learners develop self- discipline as they work collaboratively in pairs or groups to model multiplication as

repeated addition of numbers 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 by 4 and 5 using counters.

● Digital literacy: Interacting with digital technology as the learner plays adapted digital games involving multiplication

Values

• Unity: Cooperation in sharing resources amicably as they model multiplication as repeated addition.

Values:

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:

• Financial literacy as learners visits the local market to see how different fruits and other items are arranged in groups of 3's, 4's, 5's

or 10's for selling.

Link to other learning areas:

• Learner relates multiplication skills to consumer education in Environmental activities.

Suggested Learning resources:

● Bottle tops, marbles, stones, sticks, grains, multiplication tables
